description: IB III, 29a. Poem composed and written by Avraham Ibn Yijū in honor of Labrāṭ b. Moshe b. Labrāt Ibn Sughmār. Location: Yemen. Dating: ca. 1140 CE. Another draft of this poem by Ibn Yijū appears on T-S G2.59v (PGPID 39485). On the opposite side of the bifolio, there is a seliḥa also written by Ibn Yijū.
description_he: ספר הודו III,29א: שיר מאברהם בן יג'ו לכבוד לברט בן משה בן לברט אבן סוגמאר, תימן, כ-1140
